reason: Requires real Lootr containers, server ticks, saved-data flush/reload, and concurrent player interaction.

preconditions: Place one unopened Lootr container with deterministic loot.
Create two survival players at the container.
steps: Schedule both players to open the container in the same server tick.
Have the first player remove one marked stack.
Have the second player reopen the container.
assertions: Both players observe the same inventory identity and slot contents.
The removed marked stack is absent for both players and is not duplicated.

preconditions: Generate a shared Lootr inventory and mutate a known slot.
steps: Flush saved data and stop the test server cleanly.
Restart with the same world and open the container as a different player.
Invoke the supported clear/reset path and open it again.
assertions: After restart the different player sees the persisted shared mutation.
No legacy player-keyed inventory becomes readable.
Clear removes shared inventory truth once and the next generation occurs once.
